## Summary

Patch release for Windows with AI-understanding and stability improvements: an AssemblyAI Universal-3.5 Pro streaming provider, detect-language and Auto language quick-toggle for STT, scannable adaptive notes for typed chat answers, an Active Session pill on MeetingDetails, richer cloud-sync refresh, and several fixes that eliminate meeting-UI freezes and keep the TopPill floating on top.

## What's New

- **Active Session pill** on MeetingDetails with an instant-lag stop fix — the meeting session state is now always visible in one place
- **AssemblyAI Universal-3.5 Pro streaming provider** added, reported per-call via `language_detection`
- **Auto option in the STT language quick-toggle** — let the engine detect the spoken language automatically

## Improvements

- **Scannable adaptive notes layout for typed chat answers** — recap/clarify/follow-up quick actions now request scannable notes instead of a verbose prose narrative, so answers are easier to skim
- **Auto-refresh MeetingDetails** title/summary/usage after a post-stop finalize — data no longer goes stale
- **Cloud sync** now refreshes the launcher when a cloud pull updates local meetings

## Fixes

- **Meeting UI freeze eliminated** — audio-init and RAG awaits are now bounded so a hung lifecycle promise can no longer stall the meeting window
- **TopPill z-order on Windows** self-heals so it always floats on top
- **Mode ordering** — the built-in General default is now pinned above custom general-template modes

## Technical

- `electron/ipc/credentials.ts` — credentials IPC handlers extracted for cleaner separation

## ⚠️ Windows Installation (Unsigned Build)

When running the installer on Windows, you might see a "Windows protected your PC" warning from Microsoft Defender SmartScreen saying it prevented an unrecognized app from starting.

Since this is an unsigned build, this is expected. You can safely ignore it by clicking **More info** and then **Run anyway**.
